task.title: Turn and lane change signal operation

keywords.indexterm: lighting control turn and lane change signal operation

context.p: The vehicle must be in the ON position for the turn signals to function.

step.cmd: To engage the turn signal, move the lever up or down (1).

stepresult.p: The green arrow indicators on the instrument panel indicate which turn signal is operating.
The turn signal will cancel itself after you complete a turn. If the indicator continues to flash after a turn, manually return the lever to the OFF position.

step.cmd: To signal a lane change, move the turn signal lever slightly and hold it in position (2).

stepresult.p: The lever will return to the OFF position when released.

result.p: If an indicator stays on and does not flash, or if it flashes abnormally, one of the turn signal bulbs may be burned out and need to be replaced.
